GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-11-13T20:43:24Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How to rewrite url when using routers
Description: Hello, trying to rewrite the url to redirect requests but having some problems when the url doesn't have a trailing slash. Here is a minimal app to demonstrate.

```js
const express = require('express')
const app = express()
const port = 3000
const router = express.Router()

const subFolder = '/forum'

app.use(subFolder, rewrite);

function rewrite(req, res, next) {
    console.log(req.path)
    if (req.path !== '/') {
        return next()
    }
    req.url = '/categories'
    app.handle(req, res, next);
}

router.get('/regular-page', (req, res) => res.send('Hello World!'))
router.get('/categories', (req, res) => res.send('Categories'));
app.use(subFolder, router);

app.listen(port, () => console.log(`Example app listening on port ${port}!`))
```

The goal is to redirect `localhost:3000/forum` and `localhost:3000/forum/` to `localhost:3000:/forum/categories`. Right now only `localhost:3000/forum/` works. The other just 404s.

Thanks.
